result.description:
🚀 Enhanced Vision-Only Perception for UCSD Robocar Framework 🚀

This fork of ucsd_robocar_basics2_pkg extends the UCSD Robocar Framework to support Tesla-style, vision-only autonomous perception. The goal is to replace LiDAR-based navigation with an optimized, real-time computer vision system using deep learning-based object detection, monocular depth estimation, and vision-based path planning.

Key Enhancements:
✅ Real-Time Object Detection using YOLOv8-Tiny optimized for Jetson Nano/Xavier with TensorRT.
✅ Monocular Depth Estimation for scene understanding and obstacle localization without LiDAR.
✅ Enhanced Lane Detection & Segmentation using CNN-based road feature extraction.
✅ Object-Aware Navigation with dynamic path adjustments based on detected obstacles.
✅ Optimized for Edge Deployment, achieving <30ms latency per frame for real-time inference.

This project serves as a research and development effort to explore how vision-based autonomy can be implemented at a scaled-down level, drawing inspiration from Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (FSD) system.

📌 Tags: ROS2, Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Autonomous Driving, Jetson, TensorRT, Perception, UCSD Robocar
